task:
Implement a focused CHARACTER ACTION-MACHINE rewrite for Maples in Character.js only. Return ONLY a canonical unified diff. No prose, no new files, no unrelated cleanup. Preserve all existing Character public interfaces used by Game, RowanAnimationDirector, enhancements and tests.

Make Character the sole authoritative source for Rowan action state/timing. Preserve state, stateTime, stateDuration, comboIndex, dead, invuln, speed, facing, position, beginAttack, beginDodge, takeDamage, update, and the current one-shot melee hit query/event contract. Do not require changes in other files to remain syntactically/runtime compatible.

Combat feel: crisp 3-hit sword chain with distinct startup/active/recovery timing; exactly one melee-hit event per swing; reliable ~180ms buffered attack request so a press late in recovery chains cleanly; clean combo continuation/reset; noticeably heavier third hit; controlled combo-specific forward commitment/weight transfer without freezing all locomotion; stable facing through active frames so attacks cannot snap 180 degrees mid-strike. Add explicit dodge i-frames, preserve commitment, and allow a fair dodge cancel only in late attack recovery rather than at any point. Cast/hurt/dead states must remain coherent.

Timing must be robust under externally scaled dt/hit-stop: do not create duplicate Game-owned cooldown authority or a second parallel clock. Keep stateTime/stateDuration coherent for RowanAnimationDirector. Avoid per-frame allocations where easy. Keep movement and existing animation pose behavior intact outside the action changes. Prefer a compact production patch over a rewrite of unrelated rendering code.
